task_instruction: Rewrite each direct statement in reported speech. Change the tense and time expressions where necessary.
paragraphs: The school newspaper reporter, Daniel, interviews graduates and staff after the ceremony. Graduate Aisha describes her final week at school. {{red:"I have finished my last exams."}} {{mask_1}} She points to the decorated hall. {{red:"Our families are arriving now."}} {{mask_2}} Her friend Mateo shares his plans. {{red:"I will study engineering next year."}} {{mask_3}} He adds, {{red:"We celebrated with our class yesterday."}} {{mask_4}}

Daniel speaks with the principal, Ms. Chen, about the ceremony. She explains, {{red:"The students have worked hard this year."}} {{mask_5}} She looks at the stage and says, {{red:"We are giving every graduate a certificate today."}} {{mask_6}} A teacher tells Daniel, {{red:"I have taught this class for three years."}} {{mask_7}} The principal adds, {{red:"The school will post the photographs tomorrow."}} {{mask_8}}

Several graduates talk about their experiences. Aisha says, {{red:"I was nervous before the speeches began."}} {{mask_9}} Mateo tells Daniel, {{red:"My parents are waiting outside the hall."}} {{mask_10}} Another graduate explains, {{red:"I can speak to the guests after the ceremony."}} {{mask_11}} Her classmate adds, {{red:"We may visit our teachers next month."}} {{mask_12}}

Later, Daniel interviews the music teacher, Mr. Lewis. He explains why the school choir performed. {{red:"We have practiced this song since September."}} {{mask_13}} He points to the choir and says, {{red:"They are singing their final song now."}} {{mask_14}} He recalls the rehearsal. {{red:"The graduates chose the music last week."}} {{mask_15}} Then he describes the next event. {{red:"We will hold a reception here this evening."}} {{mask_16}}

Daniel writes his article the following morning and includes several comments from the ceremony. Aisha said, {{red:"I am proud of my classmates."}} {{mask_17}} Mateo said, {{red:"I have already received an offer from a university."}} {{mask_18}} Ms. Chen said, {{red:"The graduates will remain part of our school community."}} {{mask_19}} Mr. Lewis said, {{red:"The choir performed beautifully last night."}} {{mask_20}} Daniel finishes by describing the graduates' plans and the joyful ceremony.
